This '''individual''' was a member of the [[Revwien/Legends|Revwien]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Sometime prior to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], it lived in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Mos Nytram/Legends|Mos Nytram]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It auctioned to local resident [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] a [[Zephyr-G swoop/Legends|Zephyr-G swoop]] that was later used by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to track down and slaughter the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] that had captured his [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|mother]].
